title: Seattle Private Pride Walk Tour: LGBTQIA+ Stories of Capitol Hill
includes: Stroll through historic Cal Anderson Park on Capitol Hill
Join an English-speaking guide on a small group Pride walk
Enjoy drinks/treats from local LGBTQIA+-owned businesses
Follow the AIDS Memorial Pathway and reflect on its art
Explore iconic venues with queer music and drag history
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

For this tour, we can cater for the following dietary requirements: vegetarians. Please provide this information at least 24-hours prior to your travel date.. Unfortunately, we are not able to cater for any other dietary requirements that are not listed above.

blurb:
Capitol Hill is Seattle's vibrant gayborhood, rich in history and culture. This walking tour reveals stories of one of the largest U.S. LGBTQIA+ communities. Stroll through Cal Anderson Park, site of Seattle's first pride marches, and experience the AIDS Memorial Pathway. Learn about Capitol Hill's key role in supporting this community. Stop at Cupcake Royale, a business championing LGBTQIA+ rights for 20+ years, and finish with a unique coffee cocktail. Explore iconic music venues and public art celebrating diversity in this lively neighborhood.

-Discover unique spots in Capitol Hill, Seattle's beloved gayborhood.
-Learn about Seattle’s LGBTQIA+ history & the AIDS Memorial Pathway.
-Enjoy a treat at a queer-owned bakery & drink at an artisanal coffee bar.
-Walk past legendary music venues and public art celebrating inclusion.
